newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BBL up on profit rise, GBL up on BBL speculation.
newsitem.headline: BBL up on profit rise, GBL up on BBL speculation.

text.p: Shares in Belgian bank BBL jumped almost four percent on Wednesday after the company announced net profit rose 15.1 percent, while holding company Groupe Bruxelles Lambert SA (GBL) shot up almost six percent on speculations it was about to sell its stake in BBL.
"GBL may do away with its BBL stake, which would produce an enormous liquidity for the GBL group, this has pushed up the stock," one trader said.
He added that BBL's 1996 group net profit of 10.29 billion Belgian francs was in line with market expectations.
Trader Benoit Kint at brokerage Petercam said GBL shares were possibly up on rumours that GBL would make some important annoucements.
By 1525 GMT BBL was up 3.412 percent at 8,190 francs, while GBL was up 3.47 percent at 5,070, after earlier having climbed almost six percent.
